newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime says to negotiate with Oriental Bank.
newsitem.headline: Sime says to negotiate with Oriental Bank.

text.p: Malaysia's Sime Darby Bhd said it has received approval from the central bank to start negotiations with Oriental Bank Bhd with a view to acquiring a majority equity interest in the bank.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange which was made available on Wednesday, conglomerate Sime said however that it has not started negotiations on the matter.

Sime was replying to a query from the exchange on a newspaper report which said the company has Bank Negara's approval to negotiate with Malaysian Industrial Development Finance Bhd (MIDF) on merging the two commercial banks owned by the companies.
The Star newspaper said on December 5 that MIDF's 78.4 percent owned Oriental Bank may merge with Sime's United Malayan Banking Corp Bhd.
"Sime Darby...has received approval from Bank Negara Malaysia to commence negotiations with the shareholders of Oriental Bank Bhd with a view to acquiring a majority equity interest.
"However, the company would like to advise that it has not commenced negotiations on the matter," Sime said in a two-paragraph statement.
